result.summary: The page appears to be a well-designed food delivery app home screen with no critical issues. However, there are a few minor layout and content observations that could be improved for better visual consistency and user experience.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section shows only one full card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) and a partially visible second card (pizza). The second card is cut off at the bottom, which may confuse users about whether there is more content to scroll.
issues.suggestion: Ensure that list sections display complete cards or provide a clear visual indicator (like a fade or arrow) that more content is available by scrolling.

issues.description: The promotional banner says '3 free deliveries for you' with a code 'TALLINN3', but it's not immediately clear if this is a new user offer, a limited-time promotion, or a recurring benefit.
issues.suggestion: Add a small subtitle or icon to clarify the offer's eligibility or duration (e.g., 'For new users' or 'This week only').

issues.description: The 'See all' links in the 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections are aligned to the right but don't have a consistent visual style (e.g., underline, arrow icon) to indicate they are clickable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right arrow icon or underline to 'See all' links to make them more clearly interactive.
